[[Garbok's Cane]] is a [[unique item|unique]] [[wand]] dropped by [[Garbok Handsmasher]], a [[boss]] who can be found in [[Sorrow's Furnace]].

==Stats==
:[[Chaos damage]]: 11-22 (Requires 9 [[Domination Magic]])
:Halves skill recharge of [[Inspiration Magic]] [[spell]]s (Chance: 20%)
:Halves casting time of Inspiration Magic spells (Chance: 20%)

==Replica==
This item cannot be replicated. Inscription and wand wrapping would result in HCT and HSR of [[Domination Magic]] instead of [[Inspiration Magic]].
